name: Hack Squat
steps: Set your back against the hack squat pad, position your shoulders beneath the supports and plant both feet on the platform.
Brace your trunk and straighten your legs enough to release the safety handles.
Bend your hips and knees until you reach a depth you can control with your heels and back supported.
Drive evenly through your full feet to extend your legs and press the sled back up to the starting position.
tips: Keep your heels planted flat on the platform and your lower back pressed firmly against the pad throughout the descent.
Avoid locking your knees hard at the top of each repetition.
